description: This file defines an abstract class DownloadFormat within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the Maintenance DownloadFormats plugin. The class provides a base for formatting download data related to employees, including methods for generating filenames for downloads based on employee data.

classes.name: DownloadFormat
classes.description: An abstract class providing a template for generating employee data download formats, including filename generation and formatting methods.

methods.name: getFormattedString
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to return a formatted string based on provided values.

methods.name: getDownloadFileName
methods.description: Generates a filename for download based on the employee's full name and termination status.

methods.name: getEmployeeService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of EmployeeService to fetch employee data.
